paragraphs.zh: To a clean and pre-dried 100mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (10mL) NMSBA (1.0g, 0.004mol) and N, N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (0.8g, 0.004mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. Tothismixture, 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (0.45g, 0.004mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was quenched with water (10mL) and separated the organic layer. The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as off white crystalline solid.
paragraphs.en: To a clean and pre-dried 100mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (10mL) NMSBA (1.0g, 0.004mol) and N, N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC) (0.8g, 0.004mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. Tothismixture, 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (0.45g, 0.004mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was quenched with water (10mL) and separated the organic layer. The organic layer obtained was concentrated to obtain enol ester as off white crystalline solid.
paragraphs.notes: Marker transcribed exactly as printed and NOT zero-padded. Printing oddities kept as printed: 'Tothismixture,' is set solid with no spaces between the three words; 'dichloromethane (10mL) NMSBA' has no comma or conjunction between them, the line simply wraps; 'N, N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide' is printed with a space after the first comma, whereas Example 6 prints 'N,N’-' with none. The prime on the second nitrogen is a typographic right single quotation mark on the page, not a straight apostrophe, and is transcribed as such. '1, 3-cyclohexanedione' has a space after the comma and the hyphen before 'cyclohexanedione' is part of the chemical name, not a line-break hyphen, although the page happens to break the line at that hyphen. Quantities re-read at about 4x: 100mL, 10mL, 1.0g, 0.004mol, 0.8g, 0.004mol, 25-30, 0.45g, 0.004mol, 2 hours, 10mL. Mole cross-check performed and consistent: 1.0g NMSBA, 0.8g DCC and 0.45g 1,3-cyclohexanedione are each about 0.004mol, so no printed number contradicts another.

paragraphs.en: Synthesis of enol ester of formula (II) from NMSBA of formula (III):

paragraphs.zh: To a clean and pre-dried 250mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (100mL) NMSBA (25g, 0.10mol) and 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (12g, 0.11mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. To this mixture, N,N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide(DCC) (21g, 0.10mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was filtered under vacuum to obtain the wet cake. The wet cake is dried to obtain the crude enol ester. The crude enol ester with water was filtered under vacuum to obtain pure enol ester as off white colour solid.
paragraphs.en: To a clean and pre-dried 250mL round bottomed flask, dichloromethane (100mL) NMSBA (25g, 0.10mol) and 1, 3-cyclohexanedione (12g, 0.11mol) were added under stirring at the temperature of 25-30°C. To this mixture, N,N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide(DCC) (21g, 0.10mol) was added and stirred for about 2 hours at 25-30°C. The reaction mixture was filtered under vacuum to obtain the wet cake. The wet cake is dried to obtain the crude enol ester. The crude enol ester with water was filtered under vacuum to obtain pure enol ester as off white colour solid.
paragraphs.notes: Marker transcribed exactly as printed and NOT zero-padded. Printing oddities kept as printed: 'dichloromethane (100mL) NMSBA' again has no comma or conjunction, the line wraps there; 'N,N’-dicyclohexylcarbodiimide(DCC)' has NO space between the name and the opening bracket, where Example 5 prints 'dicyclohexylcarbodiimide (DCC)' WITH a space; 'To this mixture,' is correctly spaced here, where Example 5 prints 'Tothismixture,' set solid. Tense shifts mid-paragraph, 'The wet cake is dried' in the present against past tense throughout; kept as printed. 'off white colour solid' is not hyphenated. Quantities re-read at about 4x, and '0.11mol' in particular was re-read at about 10x to confirm the two glyphs after the decimal point are both the digit one and not a one followed by a lower-case L: 250mL, 100mL, 25g, 0.10mol, 12g, 0.11mol, 25-30, 21g, 0.10mol, 2 hours. Mole cross-check performed and consistent: 25g NMSBA is about 0.10mol, 12g 1,3-cyclohexanedione is about 0.107mol which rounds to the printed 0.11mol, and 21g DCC is about 0.10mol. Note the order of addition is reversed relative to Example 5: here the dione is charged with the NMSBA and the DCC added afterwards, and the product is isolated by filtration of the cake rather than from the organic layer.
